Our medical device documentation repository has been failing CI checks because of inconsistent markdown formatting across all our docs. The docs team has asked me to get this sorted out before our next regulatory submission review next week.

Specifically:
1. We need a standard formatting configuration file (`.markdownlint.json`) at the root of the repo so that everyone on the team uses the same rules going forward.
2. The existing docs under `docs/` are a mess — there are horizontal divider lines scattered throughout many files (the `---` separator lines that some authors use to visually separate sections). These need to be cleaned up, but we MUST NOT touch the YAML metadata blocks at the top of certain files (the ones that start and end with `---`) — those are critical for our document management system.
3. Several code snippets in our docs don't specify what programming language they are, which is apparently causing formatting check failures that can't be auto-corrected.
4. After cleaning everything up, all the docs under `docs/` must pass the formatting checker with zero violations.

Please fix the repository so it meets these requirements. The `scripts/` directory already has the tooling we need.
